payload.core_mechanism_summary: Greedy one-pass DP with four counters tracking max number of prefixes C, CH, CHE, CHEF that can be formed, using min constraints to avoid reusing characters.
payload.rationale: The solution uses four integer variables iteratively updated with min caps, representing a 1D DP state (counts of formed subsequence prefixes). No 2D array, recursion, or tree structure.
